# Monorepo of Pi extensions (sleek-ui, edit-message, modgate), one package per
# subdirectory and no manifest at the root. Pi's git: source cannot address a
# subdirectory, so install.sh clones this at the pinned commit and
# settings.json references the subdirectories as relative local packages.
